title: Cardiomyopathy: hypertrophic, ischemic or unspecified
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's cardiomyopathy (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for cardiac monitoring.

HPI
The patient is an 86-year-old female presenting for a routine follow-up of her cardiac status. She reports feeling well today and denies any episodes of chest pain, shortness of breath, or palpitations. She remains stable on her current regimen and has not experienced any syncopal episodes. She is here to review the results of her most recent cardiac imaging.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Aspirin 81mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. She appears in no acute distress. Heart rate is 72 beats per minute, regular. Blood pressure is 118/74 mmHg. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema noted.

Assessment
1. Nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. The patient is currently asymptomatic and stable.

Plan
1. Nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: Continue current management. The patient will continue to be monitored yearly as per the cardiologist's recommendations. Follow up in one year or sooner if symptoms develop.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Nonobstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: I42.2, other hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCC 227).
